decisions.why: all four examples are examination-imaging devices used in forensic/sexual-assault examination clinics — KernelMed handheld video colposcope, KAPS Vico HD video camera, and the MediScan / MediScan Compact HD capture-and-archive systems that drive them; a video colposcope is a gynaecological examination device, consistent with this supplier's Gynaecology division already mapped to womens:gyn

the single example, DIFRA, is the audiometric diagnostic equipment range (audiometers/tympanometry) that this supplier distributes; the supplier's ENT treatment units and chairs are filed separately under its Furniture division, so this row is the diagnostic equipment line
